hypothesis: A high variance risk premium (VIX well above 20-day realized vol) means investors are over-insured and hedging flows support ES the next session; a low or negative VRP (realized above implied) means vol-targeting deleveraging continues. Long ES 09:35->15:55 in the top VRP tail, short in the bottom tail, beats side-matched random twins.
overlap_with_closed: V3 (VIX/VIX3M slope change) and K4 (crypto DVOL/RV regime choosing follow/fade of range breaks) are closed; this is the ES index VRP level as a direct next-day direction signal, a different input and use. G1 (this batch) used VIX9D/VIX.
timestamp_semantics: VIX = bar['daily']['VIX'] (Cboe close dated the previous ES session); RV20 from bar['hist'] (prior sessions only).

rules.rv20: sample sd of the last 20 bar['hist'] 'ret' values that are not None and have nyse_skipped == 0 (fewer than 20 -> no signal), x sqrt(252) x 100 (vol points).
rules.history: strategy-kept history of VRP over prior sessions (warmup included), up to 250, needs >= 120; today's value joins after the decision.
rules.signal: VRP >= quantile(history, q) -> long; VRP <= quantile(history, 1 - q) -> short.
rules.entry_exit: evaluator shape: market at 09:35, 1:1 k x ATR20(tr) about the 09:30 close, flat 15:55.

count_check: before the run, from bar['daily'] and bar['hist'] only; drop configs under 200, replace nothing.
expected_sign: positive mean net R; q = 0.90 not weaker than q = 0.67.
against_the_mechanism: Report: long leg vs short leg.
Report only: VIX-level control (series='vix_level': x = VIX). If it does as well, VRP adds nothing beyond VIX.
Report only: realized-vol control (series='neg_rv': x = -RV20, so low realized vol -> long). If it does as well, this is realized-vol timing, not a premium.
